definitions.explanation: A shop where almost everything costs 100 yen plus tax: household goods, stationery, kitchenware, snacks and more. Big chains include Daiso and Seria.

examples.japanese: {百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought it at a 100-yen shop.

examples.japanese: {百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧そろう。
examples.english: You can find anything at a 100-yen shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought stationery and cleaning supplies all at once at the 100-yen shop in front of the station.

notes:
Often written 100⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧, and in speech usually shortened to ⟦{百均|ひゃっきん}→百均：33719_hyakkin⟧. Not every item costs 100 yen: many shops also sell goods at 300 or 500 yen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a 100-yen shop
- {百円|ひゃくえん}ショップ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: 100-yen shop goods
